text:
sophia: Quick proposal — switch the nightly oncall passoff to a 20-minute 'quick pass' starting tonight? Keep it tight: 5m quick status, 10m open incidents, 5m escalations/volunteers. Trial for 2 weeks if people +1. @here

mike: +1 from me. Can we add a 'blocking deploys' checkbox? Deploy talk usually eats time.

raj: I can cover escalation tonight. I'll bring notes for the latency incident and a short list of currently failing checks.

oncall-bot: Incident #4532 — latency spikes detected, assigned to raj. https://incidents.internal/4532 (auto-update)

anna: timezone Q — can we alternate the 20-min slot so APAC folks don't always have the late one? Happy to swap weeks.

mike: propose rotating escalation attendance weekly (week A: mike/raj, week B: anna/sophia). Also suggest this compact agenda template:

```
- Quick status (5m)
- Outstanding incidents (10m)
- Blocking deploys / roll-forward (3m)
- Volunteers / escalations (2m)
```

Bridge: https://zoom.us/j/xxxxxxxxxx  (please keep mics muted unless speaking)

sophia: love it. I'll update the calendar invite to 20m and paste the agenda in the event. Trial starts tonight 21:00 UTC. Volunteers for escalation week 1: @raj, @mike. Week 2: @anna. If you can't make your week, drop a + here and swap. :thumbsup:

raj: got it. I'll post a short digest in #incidents after the passoff with links to stack traces and top traces.

mike: small ask — can someone add a 'regression test quick-check' tickbox in the runbook? Saves time when triaging recurring alerts.

sophia: added the runbook note and the deploy checkbox. thanks everyone — I'll send updated calendar & invite notes now. cc: @ops-lead for visibility.
